full_prompt_en: A square color interior photograph presents a richly decorated bedroom in deep charcoal, burgundy, and crimson, with a large bed set against a dark wall of oversized red flowers. The camera looks into the room from the foreground, where polished dark wood floorboards give way to a broad red patterned rug. At the back center, the bed has a dark curved headboard, piled red pillows, and layered brown-red bedding; a floral mural or oversized painted panel rises behind it to the ceiling cornice. A second large floral canvas leans along the left wall, adding another concentrated burst of warm red against charcoal paint. On the far left, an arched window admits bright daylight over a low dark desk and a small patterned chair. A tall arrangement of orange-red branches sits near the window, its fine leaves catching the light. On either side of the bed, compact dark side tables hold lamps with simple pale cylindrical shades. At the right foreground, a low curving lounge chair covered in thick white shag fabric contrasts sharply with the dark setting; behind it is a red upholstered armchair and a narrow round metal table. The ceiling glows with a red treatment, while deep gray columns and trim give the room a structured frame. Light from the left window provides the main direction, brightening the white chair and the near floor, while small lamps add warm points around the bed. The photographic detail preserves velvet, patterned textile, wood sheen, and the shaggy upholstery. No people or readable text appear. The overall composition is lush but controlled, using dark architectural framing to hold intense floral reds and one bright tactile foreground form.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色室内摄影呈现一间装饰浓郁的卧室，深炭色、酒红与绯红交织，大床靠在巨幅红花覆盖的暗墙前。镜头从前景望入房间，抛光深木地板接上一张宽阔的红色纹样地毯。后方中央，大床有深色弧形床头、层叠的红枕头和棕红床品；床后花卉壁画或大幅彩绘板一直升到天花板线脚。第二幅大型花卉画靠在左墙，为炭灰墙面又添一团浓烈暖红。最左侧，拱形窗将明亮日光洒到低矮深色书桌与一把花纹椅上。窗边一束高高的橙红色枝叶接住光，细叶清楚可见。床两侧的小型深色床头桌上摆着简单浅色圆筒灯罩的台灯。右侧前景，一张低矮弯曲的休闲椅覆着厚厚的白色长毛面料，与暗环境强烈对照；后面是红色软包扶手椅与一张窄小圆金属桌。天花板带红色处理，深灰立柱与线脚给房间稳固的结构。左窗光是主光，照亮白椅与近处地板，小灯则在床周围添上暖亮点。摄影细节保留天鹅绒、纹样织物、木面光泽和蓬松椅套的不同触感。画中没有人物或可读文字。整体构图丰盛却受控，以深色结构框架承托浓烈花红和一块明亮而可触的前景形态。
style_prompt_en: The polished color photograph balances deep charcoal fields with concentrated warm red accents and a small area of luminous pale texture. Dark structural lines and broad shadowed planes provide a disciplined frame for dense ornamental patterns. Soft, tactile surfaces shift between matte pile, gentle sheen, and intricate weave, making material contrast as important as hue. A broad side source creates the main gradients of light, while smaller warm points glow within the darker recesses. Saturated color gathers in the middle distance and repeats in smaller foreground fragments; the brightest pale area sits closer to the viewer and pulls the eye forward. The composition is layered and symmetrical only in broad terms, with curves interrupting its straight edges. The overall effect is sumptuous and theatrical yet carefully organized by value and material.
style_prompt_zh: 这种精致的彩色摄影以深炭色场平衡集中的暖红色重音和一小片发亮的浅色纹理。深色结构线与宽阔背阴平面为密集装饰纹样提供受控框架。柔软而可触的表面在哑光绒毛、温和光泽与细密编织之间变化，让材料对比与色相同样重要。宽阔侧光形成主要明暗渐层，较小的暖亮点则在深处发光。饱和色聚在中景，并以较小碎片在前方重复；最亮的浅色区域靠近观者，把视线拉向前景。构图只在大体上对称，曲线不断打断直线边缘。整体效果丰盛而戏剧化，又被明度与材料仔细组织。
theme_en: A dramatic dark bedroom layered with red floral art and textured fabrics
theme_zh: 深色卧室里层叠红色花卉画与纹理织物
name: Candice Olson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
